metadata.title: Artists for brands: painting and clay
metadata.description: We collaborate with painters and clay artists on campaigns, activations, and handcrafted brand content presented authentically on social media.

hero.lucram_cu_artisti_in_care_credem_si_pe_c: We work with artists we believe in and promote. When a brand needs something that cannot be generated, we bring them into the project.

ce_putem_face_impreuna.ce_pot_face_pentru_brandul_tau: What I can do for your brand
ce_putem_face_impreuna.pentru_o_campanie_un_produs_sau_un_ambal: for a campaign, a product, or packaging.
ce_putem_face_impreuna.pentru_continut_sau_pentru_spatiul_tau: for content or for your space.
ce_putem_face_impreuna.pentru_o_lansare_sau_un_eveniment: for a launch or an event.
ce_putem_face_impreuna.pentru_clienti_sau_pentru_echipa: for clients or for your team.
ce_putem_face_impreuna.alegem_impreuna_ce_fac_artistii_pentru_t: We choose together what the artists will create for you. We handle everything, from the brief to the post.
ce_putem_face_impreuna.artistii_sunt_creditati_in_fiecare_proie: Artists are credited in every project and also appear on the na account.

cum_lucram_cu_artistii.ne_spui_ce_vrei_sa_spui_si_unde_va_apare: Tell us what you want to say and where it will appear.
cum_lucram_cu_artistii.potrivim_stilul_artistului_cu_brandul_ta: We match the artist's style to your brand.
cum_lucram_cu_artistii.vezi_directia_inainte_de_lucrarea_finala: You see the direction before the final piece.
cum_lucram_cu_artistii.artistul_o_face_noi_o_aducem_in_continut: The artist creates it; we incorporate it into the content and credit them.

ne_vedem_la_cafea.vorbim_deschis_despre_ce_ai_nevoie_si_ca: Let's talk openly about what you need and what it costs. Seriously, the coffee is on us.

artist_profiles.pictorita_profesionista_cu_o_viziune_car: A professional painter with an instantly recognizable vision. She creates commissioned paintings, each inspired by the person or story behind it. For a brand, that means a one-of-a-kind piece unlike anything else in the feed.
artist_profiles.artist_in_lut_face_figurine_obiecte_si_v: A clay artist. He makes figurines, objects, and vases. Every piece passes through his hands, from its first shape to its final detail, so no two are alike.
